hero.summary_en: The Czech Republic is automatically covered at calendar level from the official Dostihy.cz national calendar.
hero.summary_ja: チェコはDostihy.cz公式全国カレンダーからカレンダーレベルで自動取得します。

paragraphs_en: The production route follows official national calendar event pages, pairing Datum konání with the Štítky venue label. The current reviewed venue mapping covers Praha, Pardubice, Karlovy Vary, Most, Slušovice, Lysá nad Labem, Brno, Kolesa and Netolice. Public output remains rank C.
paragraphs_ja: production導線は公式全国カレンダーの各event pageからDatum konáníとŠtítky会場表記を組み合わせます。現在のレビュー済み会場mappingはPraha、Pardubice、Karlovy Vary、Most、Slušovice、Lysá nad Labem、Brno、Kolesa、Netoliceです。公開はCのままです。

calendar_guidance_en: Use only source-visible official meeting dates and mapped physical venues; do not infer post times or cancellation from absence.

coverage_note_en: Automatic national Calendar coverage is rank C: meeting date plus physical venue.
